program_name: Outcome-unseen validation of neighborhood knowledge borrowing
status: target programme frozen from catalog and repository metadata only; target outcome files not downloaded or inspected under this programme
purpose: Test whether the complete borrowing strategy improves few-shot and OOD performance on new targets, including a reverse transport direction and a second scientific family.
claim_guard: Target selection does not predict a positive result. Every frozen target and source remains in the denominator. Retrospective success cannot be called prospective discovery.

targets.allowed_pre_ingestion_metadata: Experimental thermoelectric property curves with downloadable records and article provenance; no target values or high-performing identities inspected before this freeze.
target_properties: electrical conductivity or power factor as prespecified secondary endpoints
nominated_sources: ESTM thermoelectric measurements as same-domain reference
OBELiX experimental solid-electrolyte ionic conductivity as adjacent transport source
Caltech experimental Li-ion conductivity as an independent adjacent transport source
targets.scientific_test: Determine whether ionic-transport sources add target regions beyond the best same-domain thermoelectric source and whether the thermoelectric-to-ionic relation has a useful reverse direction.
minimum_quality: at least 20 true nonmissing observations in each primary held-out scope

targets.allowed_pre_ingestion_metadata: High-throughput acid-OER Mn-Sb-Sn-Ti-Co composition-spread libraries with XRF, XRD, and electrochemistry files; no OER activity values or candidate identities inspected before this freeze.
target_properties: prespecified OER activity figure of merit from oer_all_foms.csv
nominated_sources: OCx experimental CO2-reduction catalyst measurements as adjacent electrocatalysis source
an independent HTEM or MEAD optoelectrochemical source selected by metadata and provenance before outcome access
targets.scientific_test: Determine whether neighboring experimental electrocatalysis knowledge supplies OOD composition proposals beyond target-only novelty while unrelated sources abstain.
minimum_quality: at least four independently held-out plates or provenance blocks

common_prediction_design.split_unit: article, plate, campaign, or provenance component
common_prediction_design.primary_endpoint: paired relative RMSE reduction versus target-only in the highest outcome-free OOD quartile
common_prediction_design.required_absolute_utility: positive augmented-model R2 in the designated held-out scope
representations: condition-aware and structure-aware representation when reported
standard_baselines: mixture of experts or multitask learner

co_primary_endpoints: acquisitions to first distinct top-5-percent component
required_tradeoffs: marginal components contributed by each source
common_exploration_design.abstention: Any source failing the frozen source-quality, target-increment, or control threshold receives zero allocation.
common_exploration_design.ood_role: OOD distance defines scopes and quotas but cannot multiply the source score.

matched_specificity_controls.source_size: subsample control sources to the nominated source entity count within each repeat
matched_specificity_controls.source_skill: select or degrade controls to overlap the nominated source OOF-skill interval
matched_specificity_controls.coverage: match nearest-source-distance distribution in the target pool
matched_specificity_controls.capacity: append an equal number of cross-fitted random features to the target model
matched_specificity_controls.shuffle: independently permute each nominated source rank within the fixed candidate pool

hypothesis_cards.timing: written, timestamped, and hashed after target features and frozen source ranks exist but before target outcomes are revealed
hypothesis_cards.minimum: one source-specific region card and one consensus-region card per target
hypothesis_cards.reporting: all cards are reported regardless of outcome

inference.within_target: paired article/plate/campaign-group bootstrap or randomization; seed variation is a conditional sensitivity only
inference.multiplicity: Holm correction over named primary contrasts within endpoint family and target
inference.across_targets: hierarchical or random-effects estimate with target-level effects and between-target heterogeneity shown
inference.success: At least one predesignated expected-positive target passes prediction and/or exploration gates beyond matched controls, while the second target has the same direction or correctly abstains without aggregate harm.

audit_sentinels: hash raw target files before parsing
hash target metadata table before outcome join
hash source predictions, components, policy orders, code, environment, and hypothesis cards before outcome reveal
record every formula, DOI, sample, plate, and parent-lineage exclusion
archive failures and abstentions in the knowledge-borrowing map
